newsitem.title: USA: AT&T wireless phones to offer Bloomberg news.
newsitem.headline: AT&T wireless phones to offer Bloomberg news.

text.p: AT&T Corp on Monday said it planned to make news and market updates from Bloomberg Financial Markets available to users of AT&T Wireless Services' PocketNet telephone.
AT&T described the PocketNet as an integrated cellular phone and wireless Internet appliance intended to provide customers with access to Internet information and two-way messaging services.
Beginning in July, PocketNet users will have wireless access to the Bloomberg Online web site.
Currently PocketNet phones are available to corporatons directly from AT&T Wireless Services, but the product will be made available through retailers later this year, AT&T said.
It sells for $549, and the service account, which will include Bloomberg access, costs about $40 per month, not including cellular phone service and activation costs.
Bloomberg Financial Markets is a unit of privately held Bloomberg LP.
